messages:
rachel (People Ops): Post-all-hands quick follow-up thread for unanswered Qs on reviews, promotions, comp, and benefits. Please keep replies short; we'll assign owners. Calibration window: 2024-09-02 to 2024-09-08; manager confirmations due 2024-09-02; retro pay target 2024-10-01.

miguel (IC): If I disagree with my manager about a level, what's the concrete escalation path?
dena (Eng Manager): Managers submit their recs into the packet. If an IC or manager thinks there's missing evidence, add peer notes to the packet or ask HR to flag during calibration. If unresolved after calibration there's an appeals window—People Ops owns that.

miguel (IC): Can a peer/PM add evidence directly?
dena (Eng Manager): Yes, peers can add written evidence. Ask your manager to include links or paste bullets into the "peer evidence" doc.

miguel (IC): Retro pay timing?

payroll-bot: Retro for approved promos in this cycle scheduled for 2024-10-01 payroll. Payroll will DM any exceptions.

rachel (People Ops): Managers: please attach 1-3 concrete artifacts (PRs, metrics, product outcomes) for any level-up rec. We'll post a short artifacts checklist in the handbook by EOD.

miguel (IC): Will there be a short FAQ on timelines + appeals?

rachel (People Ops): Yes  drafting a 1-pager and will post in #announcements and the handbook tomorrow. DM me with edge cases.

payroll-bot: Resource pinned -> /handbook/reviews/faq and /forms/appeals-request.

rachel (People Ops): Thanks all. Managers: please block calibration review time on your calendars.
